title: 商汤科技开源8B轻量多模态大模型：原生4K输出、全能视觉编辑
content:
SenseTime officially announced the open-source of a new lightweight, native unified multimodal large model, SenseNova U1.5Lite. As a lightweight model with 8B parameters, it demonstrates superior performance in multiple core visual tasks compared to models of similar scale, and even reaches a level comparable to large-scale commercial models in some complex layout and text rendering scenarios.
SenseNova U1.5Lite natively supports context lengths of 3 to 4K, enabling it to handle multiple constraints such as subject, quantity, spatial relationships, text, layout, and style simultaneously, significantly improving stability when executing complex visual tasks.
In terms of specific functional features, the model brings several core upgrades. First, it offers higher-quality visual generation, significantly improving overall composition, color, material, lighting, realism, and local details, effectively avoiding issues where traditional models produce locally correct but overall incomplete results. Second, it provides more reliable native image editing capabilities, enhancing the preservation of subject identity, spatial structure, layout relationships, and non-editable areas, while comprehensively improving the overall performance of local modifications, element replacement, text refinement, and multi-reference image editing.
Additionally, the model also performs well in handling text and complex layouts, strengthening its capabilities in Chinese and English text, posters, infographics, brand visuals, and multi-text formatting, pushing the generation of content toward complete visual expression. In terms of visual control, it supports various methods such as Bounding Box, Visual Marker, and single or multi-image references, allowing for more precise editing of specified regions and objects. More notably, it achieves native 4K high-resolution output, maintaining both the overall macro composition and extremely fine textures, small texts, and lighting effects in high-resolution generation.
Project address: https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1

report.summary: 商汤开源8B多模态模型SenseNova U1.5Lite，支持原生4K输出与全能视觉编辑。
report.background: 多模态大模型竞争日趋激烈，开源社区已有大量轻量级模型，但多数在处理复杂视觉任务时存在局部正确、整体布局失真的问题。商汤科技此前推出SenseNova系列，本次开源的U1.5Lite以8B参数主打高质量视觉生成和编辑能力，强调对文本渲染、空间关系、多约束条件的综合控制。此举意在通过开源扩大生态影响，同时展示其在视觉AI领域的技术积累，与国内外竞品形成差异化。
key_points: 8B参数实现越级视觉表现：在主体、数量、布局、风格等多约束任务中，性能匹敌大型商业模型。
原生4K高分辨率输出：兼顾宏观构图与微小纹理、小字和光照细节，解决高分辨率生成易崩坏的问题。
可靠的原生图像编辑：增强主体身份、空间结构、非编辑区域保护，支持局部修改、元素替换、多参考图编辑。
文本和复杂布局强化：中英文文本、海报、信息图、品牌视觉等场景表现更完整，推动生成内容向整体视觉表达进阶。
支持多种视觉控制方式：包括Bounding Box、Visual Marker和单/多图参考，可精确指定编辑区域和对象。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，商汤开源8B级多模态模型降低了高质量视觉生成与编辑的门槛，可能推动更多垂直应用落地。开发者可基于其原生4K和精细控制能力，构建海报设计、电商展示、内容创作等工具，减少对闭源API的依赖。普通用户未来有望在免费或低成本的本地部署产品中体验到接近商业级的图像编辑效果，尤其是在中文文本渲染和复杂版式方面获得显著提升。
report.tools: 可关注GitHub项目OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1，以及商汤官网技术文档。若想上手体验，建议使用Hugging Face推理框架或本地部署工具（如vLLM、llama.cpp）进行测试，对比其与SDXL、FLUX等开源模型的视觉编辑效果。
